ITEM 1 | Cubed pieces, bright orange-to-amber color with darker caramelized edges and some browned spots, matte surface with slight sheen, firm and holding shape, roughly 2-3 cm cubes with irregular cut faces, scattered across the upper left of a light blue plate | 120
ITEM 2 | Cubed pieces of orange flesh with pale orange-yellow interior and a thin rind-like edge on some faces, moist-looking surface, firm and holding shape, roughly 2-3 cm chunks clustered on the upper right of the plate | 110
ITEM 3 | Three to four strips of cooked bacon, reddish-pink lean meat with pale fat streaks, glossy and slightly oily, flexible strips about 1 cm wide and 8-10 cm long, lying across the lower center of the plate, with some browned edges | 40
